label: Countdown Timer
purpose: Display a countdown timer to a sale deadline or event to create urgency
_notes:
end_time MUST be in this exact format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (e.g. 2026-03-26T00:00:00). heading is inline_richtext and must NOT be wrapped in

tags (inline tags like / only). end_behavior controls what happens once end_time passes: 'hide' removes the block, 'restart' adds repeat_hours and loops, 'next_day' repeats at the same time the next day. show_days/show_hours/show_minutes/show_seconds toggle which time units are displayed; label_days/label_hours/label_minutes/label_seconds are the short unit labels (e.g. 'Days', 'Hrs', 'Mins', 'Secs') shown only when the matching show_* is true. Many other settings in the real schema (colors, borders, spacing, box styling, timezone) are pure layout/visual and intentionally excluded.
